newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks up in early morning on high-tech buys.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks up in early morning on high-tech buys.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rose in early Friday morning trade as investors bought exporters, especially high-technology shares, reassured that the yen was stabilising against the dollar, brokers said. They said position squaring ahead of the weekend was expected and gains might not last.
After 24 minutes of trade, the Nikkei average was 14.40 points or 0.07 percent higher at 20,326.63. Its June futures had lost 20 to stand at 20,290.
"High-tech issues have been moving back into the spotlight and they may help revive the blue-chip rally that was stopped short by strength in the yen," one broker said.
